_comment: 35 Scrawls across 5 slot types. draw is ink-per-shot and comes from the medium; bound_cost is the one-time ink to draw the part.

PENCIL.character: Faint, provisional. Refundable for 70%. Vulnerable to ERASE.

CRAYON.character: Waxy, childish. Randomised magnitude. Immune to wash.

PEN.character: Reliable, permanent. Immune to erasing. 2% blot misfire.

WATERCOLOUR.character: Spreads and dilutes. Strips enemy PENCIL parts on hit.

CHARCOAL.character: Filthy, high-impact. Residue clouds obscure your vision too.

MARKER.character: Bold and wasteful. Bleeds its tags into adjacent slots.

WHITEOUT.character: Anti-ink. Burst use only; you cannot sustain this.

STAPLE.character: Physical. Costs no ink to run. Uses scarce map-found staples.

parts.name: Splitter Nib
parts.effect: Shots fork into two. Damage ×0.65 each.
parts.art: a nib with a crack down the middle, drawn slightly wrong

parts.name: Arrowhead
parts.effect: Shots curve toward whatever you were last aiming at.
parts.art: a child's arrow, one barb longer than the other

parts.name: Squiggle Tip
parts.effect: Shots bounce twice. Damage ×0.9 per bounce.
parts.art: a waxy corkscrew scribbled over the barrel

parts.name: The Long Line
parts.effect: Shots draw through up to 3 targets, ×0.8 falloff each.
parts.art: one unbroken stroke someone clearly held their breath for

parts.name: Scribble Muzzle
parts.effect: +60% fire rate, spread ×2.4, wobbles as it travels.
parts.art: a furious black mess where the barrel used to be

parts.name: Blotter Cap
parts.effect: Shots leave a 2m ink pool for 6s.
parts.art: a fat felt cap, bleeding at the edges

parts.name: Stipple Tip
parts.effect: One shot becomes 5 dots. Damage ×0.28 each.
parts.art: dozens of tiny dots, applied with no patience whatsoever

parts.name: Whiteout Nozzle
parts.effect: 34% chance on hit to strip one enemy part.
parts.art: a correction-fluid brush taped over the muzzle

parts.name: Crosshatch Plating
parts.effect: −22% damage taken. You render noticeably darker.
parts.art: dense diagonal hatching, going the wrong way in places

parts.name: Second Barrel
parts.effect: A worse copy of the gun on the side. +1 shot at ×0.5 damage.
parts.art: the same gun drawn again, smaller, at a slight angle

parts.name: Eraser Shavings
parts.effect: Hits shed shavings: 18% strip chance in a 3m radius.
parts.art: rubber crumbs stuck to the frame with old tape

parts.name: Wet Coat
parts.effect: Enemies hit get blurred vision 1.5s and leak 2 pocket ink.
parts.art: a translucent wash that never fully dried

parts.name: Staple Reinforcement
parts.effect: −15% damage taken, flat. Cannot be erased.
parts.art: eleven staples where three would have done

parts.name: Margin Notes
parts.effect: Enemies you hit are marked for your team for 5s.
parts.art: annotations down the side of the gun, none of them legible

parts.name: Smudge Thumb
parts.effect: Melee becomes a 3m smear. 55 damage, knocks back.
parts.art: a greasy thumbprint pressed into the frame

parts.name: Tally Marks
parts.effect: Every hit siphons 0.4 pocket ink from the target to you.
parts.art: four strokes and a diagonal, over and over

parts.name: Squint Lines
parts.effect: 1.8× zoom, spread ×0.55 while aiming.
parts.art: two little speed-lines by the eye, added as an afterthought

parts.name: X-Ray Sketch
parts.effect: See enemies through erased and thin geometry.
parts.art: a cutaway diagram someone traced off a book

parts.name: Guide Lines
parts.effect: Dotted line predicting target movement 0.6s ahead. Shots follow it.
parts.art: construction lines that were never rubbed out

parts.name: Crosshair Doodle
parts.effect: Crosshair drifts. 12% of shots crit for ×2.2.
parts.art: a wonky X, redrawn three times, all three still visible

parts.name: Highlighter Bead
parts.effect: Anyone you look at for 0.5s is marked for your team.
parts.art: a blob of fluorescent nothing, in greyscale

parts.name: Bent Ruler
parts.effect: Perfectly straight shot, no falloff, +0.4s recovery.
parts.art: a ruler with a visible kink, taped along the barrel

parts.name: Sticky Tape
parts.effect: −40% recoil. Cannot be erased.
parts.art: three strips, one peeling, fingerprints in the adhesive

parts.name: Shaky Hand
parts.effect: +45% fire rate, spread ×1.9. Cheap and stupid.
parts.art: the outline drawn four times, none of them matching

parts.name: Rubber Band
parts.effect: −30% nib re-wet delay. −8% damage taken.
parts.art: a perished band, wrapped twice, going grey

parts.name: Knuckle Grip
parts.effect: −70% flinch when hit. −10% damage taken.
parts.art: a fist that is mostly just a lumpy blob

parts.name: Flicked Wrist
parts.effect: Shots curve on release and bounce once off geometry.
parts.art: a motion arc, drawn with more confidence than skill

parts.name: Chewed End
parts.effect: All effect magnitudes randomised ×0.6–1.5 per shot.
parts.art: unmistakably been in someone's mouth

parts.name: Pressure Grip
parts.effect: Hold to charge: up to ×2.4 damage and a 3m mark.
parts.art: the paper has visibly dented where it was pressed

parts.name: Ink Sac
parts.effect: +60% nib capacity on every part.
parts.art: a bulging sac, one seam clearly about to go

parts.name: Bottomless Well
parts.effect: Nibs never empty — every shot draws straight from your pocket.
parts.art: a hole drawn on the side of the gun, in the cartoon sense

parts.name: Leaky Barrel
parts.effect: Leaves an ink trail behind you. Costs 0.3 pocket ink/s.
parts.art: a stain spreading down from a crack, still wet

parts.name: Spare Cartridge
parts.effect: +40 staples. Works at zero ink.
parts.art: a cardboard box of staples, gaffer-taped on

parts.name: Capillary Feed
parts.effect: Nibs re-wet 55% faster.
parts.art: hair-thin lines running back along the body

parts.name: Pressurised Can
parts.effect: Fires in 4-round bursts. +30% damage, draw ×1.4.
parts.art: a dented aerosol, warning label scribbled out

parts.name: Paperclip Chain
parts.effect: Hits leave a clipped-on tag. Target marked for your team for 4s.
parts.art: a chain of paperclips, three of them bent open

parts.name: Staple Hopper
parts.effect: +90 staples and a faster feed. Works at zero ink.
parts.art: a takeaway container cable-tied to the frame
